parsed.explanation: The objection is factually right that no derivation of gcd(a,b)=gcd(min(a,b),|a-b|) appears: the text writes '(standard; details omitted)', and the degeneracy audit only tabulates how (0,b),(a,a),(0,0) transform. But the ledger statement L1.2 requires the invariance of the per-prime valuation gcd, and the write-up states the correct move law (a,b)->(min(a,b),|a-b|) with the correct valuation computations, states identity (3) correctly for all nonnegative pairs, notes gcd(0,e)=e and the a=b case explicitly, and infers invariance of G_p by associativity. Only the textbook one-line proof gcd(x,y)=gcd(x,y-x) is deferred; the mechanism and all cases are present, so L1.2 stands as written. One added sentence would close the citation.
